title: Smooth Cheddar Cheese Sauce
summary: A light roux sharpened with mustard powder and cayenne, simmered with milk, then finished with plenty of mature Cheddar and a little Parmesan.

steps.title: Start the base
steps.text: Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Add the flour, mustard powder and cayenne and stir for about 1 min until it smells fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer with milk
steps.text: Whisk in the milk slowly, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and let it bubble gently for 6-8 min, whisking often, until lightly thickened.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Lift the pan off the heat. Whisk in the Cheddar a handful at a time, letting each melt before adding more, then stir in the Parmesan.

steps.title: Serve hot
steps.text: Taste; it rarely needs salt. Pour over steamed or roasted broccoli, cauliflower or chips while hot.

tips: Grate the Cheddar yourself; ready-grated cheese has anti-caking powder that can make the sauce gritty.
Keep the heat off while the cheese melts to stop it splitting.
Loosen with a little hot milk if it thickens on standing.
Stir through 250 g cooked macaroni for a quick macaroni cheese.
storage: Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 3 days. Reheat slowly in a pan with a splash of milk, stirring constantly. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
